sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: The admitted original PDF on printed page 161 clearly enumerates seven Variationen der Triebgefahren. Canonical OCR damages several words, but the list structure and the labels Unitendenz, Tritendenz, vertical/anankastic isolation, diagonal splitting, Desintegration, Integration and Quantumspannung/Triebhypertonie are visually recoverable.

romanianRendering: Szondi enumeră șapte forme generale de Triebgefahr: Unitendenz; Tritendenz prin căderea unei tendințe vitale; izolarea unui Bedürfnis prin diviziune verticală/anankastică; desprinderea unei opoziții prin diviziune diagonală; Desintegration; Integration prin tensiune completă și excesivă; Quantumspannung/Triebüberdruck.
doctrinalStatement: Capitolul organizează analiza Triebgefahr în șapte clase de mecanisme structurale. Lista este o taxonomie metodică a modurilor de dezechilibru ale Ganztrieb-ului și servește drept schemă pentru subsecțiunile următoare; simpla apartenență formală la una dintre clase nu constituie singură un diagnostic.
conditions: Apply the sevenfold taxonomy only to source-defined reaction structures and their foreground/background organization.
exceptions: Do not infer a named disorder solely because a profile instantiates one structural division type.
Do not treat the seven types as mutually exclusive in every real protocol; the source later discusses combinations and intensification by Quantumspannung.
scopeNotes: The seven headings are method categories; later tables provide vector-specific examples and consequences.

relations.note: Enumerates the principal structural forms of the general Triebgefahr concept.

ambiguities: Several item labels are OCR-damaged in the canonical derivative; printed page 161 is clear.
reviewNotes: Canonical BODY U002368-U002377 checked against deterministic P0 evidence and admitted PDF printed page 161.
P2A only; the list does not create a syndrome or diagnosis detector.
